version_separation_summary.v3_0_frozen: Initial pre-confirmation frozen parser & rule engine (0 contract-specific aliases on the 11 confirmation PDFs; achieves 78/80 = 97.50% on slot_guard_repair across the 40 confirmation seeds, missing only fconf-ins-003 due to unmodeled pa_h716 specific-organ 90-day benefit keywords).
version_separation_summary.v3_1_posthoc_hardened: Post-review hardened parser & evaluator incorporating: (a) parse-uncertainty gating (`detect_parse_uncertainty`) for cross-unit/calendar-date inline corrections and multi-value day disjunctions (0/3 false accepts on adversarial probes), (b) forward clause reachability (`forward_reachable_under_clause`) distinguishing `FACT_MUTATED_SAME_DECISION` from `DECISION_CHANGED`, and (c) strictly isolated `predict(question, retrieved_clause, inference_config)`.
version_separation_summary.v3_1_untouched_holdout: Internal post-hardening evaluation on 24 unseen seeds (6 unseen Ping An official contract PDFs + 12 unseen multi-threshold seeds = 48 cross-model pairs across 10 document clusters) evaluated without modifying v3.1-posthoc-hardened.
version_separation_summary.audit_field_compatibility_note: In `frozen_confirmation_three_layer_audit.jsonl`, the field `v3_0_raw_outcome` is retained as a schema-compatibility alias holding the current verifier outcome (`r["outcome"]` under `v3.1-posthoc-hardened`). On the 40-seed confirmation set, `slot_guard_repair` usable yield is identical (78/80 = 97.50%) under both `v3.0-frozen` and `v3.1-posthoc-hardened`.

evaluated_model_families: qwen-plus (Alibaba DashScope Cloud API endpoint; response_model="qwen-plus")

three_layer_frozen_confirmation_audit_su.audit_provenance: shared_rule_base_dual_implementation_consistency_check (programmatic extended-lexicon + forward-reachability consistency check sharing base rule tables; NOT independent human blind annotation)

semantic_reachability_consistency.description: Compares v3.0-frozen verifier acceptance against semantic slot/reachability preservation (ignoring format truncation).

joint_format_and_semantic_usability.description: Compares v3.0-frozen verifier acceptance against joint semantic preservation AND complete single-sentence interrogative format (format_valid=True).

implementation_and_protocol_audit.structured_json_rewrite: Original confirmation baseline with max_new_tokens=160 and two-line output (first-line JSON + QUESTION line); mean total tokens = 530.6.
implementation_and_protocol_audit.structured_json_untruncated_320: Independent cloud API generation raising max_new_tokens from 160 to 320 under the identical two-line prompt; eliminates length truncation on Qwen-Plus (33/40 -> 38/40) and reaches 73/80 = 91.25% overall (mean total tokens = 533.5).
implementation_and_protocol_audit.structured_json_schema_render: Post-hoc deterministic template rendering ablation (`render_question_from_extracted_json`) over the first-line JSON extracted from the 160-token `structured_json_rewrite` responses (80/80 shared `raw_response`, zero extra API calls, inherited mean total tokens = 530.6). Isolates free-text QUESTION line drafting errors from open-ended JSON slot value extraction errors.

untouched_post_hardening_holdout_24_seed.provenance_and_scope_note: Internal post-hardening unseen-seed extension benchmark constructed after freezing v3.1-posthoc-hardened. Comprises 12 insurance seeds from 6 official Ping An health/critical-illness PDFs (`pa_2650`, `pa_1071`, `pa_1073`, `pa_595`, `pa_597`, `pa_l0002`, cached in the local contract pool on 2026-10-26 and first extracted for Round 10) plus 12 new multi-threshold seeds (`uhold-cross-001..012`) instantiated with unseen parameter combinations on the 4 multi-threshold rule templates (total = 24 seeds, 48 cross-model pairs across 10 document clusters). Because this extension set was authored within the same repository rather than by an external third party, it is reported as an internal post-hardening generalization test rather than an external third-party blind benchmark.

insurance_24_seeds.pipeline_architecture_note: Controlled retrieval + symbolic rule-decision pipelines: pure BGE-small-zh-v1.5 dense retrieval (100% vector cache coverage, zero lexical fallback) or BM25 char-2 retrieval on query text followed by isolated `predict(question, retrieved_clause, inference_config)` symbolic rule variants.

retrieval_backend_audit.dense_backend: BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5 (exact L2-normalized CLS cosine similarity, lexical fallback on cache miss disabled)
retrieval_backend_audit.lexical_zero_overlap_guard: if max(bm25_char2_scores) <= 0.0: return None (rejects zero-overlap out-of-domain strings before BGE cosine lookup)
